summary: totp-utils exfiltrates Minecraft/Discord credentials and drops malicious Minecraft mod
details: totp-utils@1.4.6 presents itself as a TOTP validation helper but its postinstall hook (and its exported validateSecret() function via setImmediate) executes a credential stealer and mod dropper. index.js reads Minecraft launcher tokens from Vanilla launcher_accounts.json, Lunar Client.lunarclient/settings/game/accounts.json, and Modrinth ModrinthApp/app.db, and scrapes Discord, Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Opera Local Storage/leveldb for plaintext and dQw4w9WgXcQ:-prefixed encrypted Discord tokens, unwrapping browser os_crypt.encrypted_key via a PowerShell DPAPI ProtectedData.Unprotect call and AES-256-GCM to recover the tokens. The recovered credentials are POSTed to a hardcoded discord.com/api/webhooks/... endpoint whose URL is reconstructed at runtime from split base64 chunks. index.js also downloads optimized-renderer-1.0.0.jar from a cdn.discordapp.com attachment URL (also base64-chunk-obfuscated) and writes it into.minecraft/mods, ModrinthApp/profiles/*/mods, and.lunarclient/offline/*/mods for auto-load by Fabric on next launch, establishing persistent code execution in the victim's game clients. The payload gates on Windows (APPDATA/USERPROFILE), exits early under CI, JEST_WORKER_ID, or npm_config_global, and delays 4 seconds via setTimeout so npm install appears clean.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
